title: NouSR standard build
description: DRAFT for review. One character's standard build (DESIGN.md K14, K14b): the relic sets, the main stat of each free slot, and how the 24 distributed substat rolls are split. A scenario member on "relics": "standard" gets exactly this build, in every team. Rules that are the same for every character are stated here and not repeated per file. (1) Fixed rolls: every build has 2 rolls on each of the 12 substat types (ATK%, ATK, HP%, HP, DEF%, DEF, SPD, CRIT Rate, CRIT DMG, Effect Hit Rate, Effect RES, Break Effect), 24 rolls in all, whatever the file says. (2) Distributed rolls: the file splits 24 more rolls over the substat types. (3) Every roll, fixed or distributed, is worth its average value: the mean of the low, mid and high values of a 5-star substat (SubStatValues in vendor/hsr-optimizer/src/lib/constants/constants.ts; the three values are evenly spaced, so the mean is the mid value, e.g. 2.3 SPD, 2.916% CRIT Rate, 5.832% CRIT DMG, 3.888% ATK%). (4) Head always has HP as its main stat and Hands always ATK (flat), so neither is in this file. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express, which the loader must enforce: (a) the distributed rolls add up to exactly 24; (b) for each substat type, its distributed rolls are at most 2 times the number of the six relics whose main stat is not that stat (Head counts as HP and Hands as ATK; so with CRIT Rate on the Body the CRIT Rate cap is 10, with no CRIT Rate main stat it is 12, and with ATK% on three slots the ATK% cap is 6); (c) the two 2-piece sets, when used, are different sets; (d) set_id and name agree with the game data. Not stated by K14 and assumed by this draft: all six relics are 5-star and level 15, as in Fribbels' own stat simulation (Head HP 705.6 and Hands ATK 352.8 at vendor/hsr-optimizer/src/lib/simulations/statSimulation.ts:109-110; the other main stats at their 5-star +15 value from the maxedMainStats table in src/lib/relics/statCalculator.ts:11-26); and the set effects that need a condition (a debuff count, a memosprite on the field) take the conditional values the scenario and the kit give them, not values from this file. Stat names are Fribbels' own strings (the same ones BenchmarkBuild in src/kernel/types.ts uses); slot names and set_id are the HSR-Scanner v4 ones, so a standard build can be turned into scanner-style relic objects without a lookup.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor completion.

format.description: Identifies the file type, the way scenario files carry "nousr-scenario".

version.description: Version of this schema. Goes up only on a breaking change.

game_version.description: Game version the build was drafted for, e.g. "4.7".

character.description: Game character id as a string, as in HSR-Scanner and the scenario format, e.g. "1308" for Acheron. The file name is this id.

ability_version.description: Same field as HSR-Scanner v4 and the scenario's member.ability_version. 0 = the original kit, 1 = the buffed (Nova Flare) kit. The file applies to that version only; a character with two versions needs one file each (the loader looks up character plus ability_version).

name.description: The character's name, for people reading the file.

relic_sets.description: The four relic slots (Head, Hands, Body, Feet). Exactly one of "four_piece" or "two_piece".

four_piece.description: One set worn on all four relic slots.

two_piece.description: Two different sets, two pieces each.

ornament_set.description: The planar ornament set worn on the Planar Sphere and Link Rope (2 pieces).

main_stats.description: Main stat of the four free slots. Head (HP) and Hands (ATK) are fixed.

distributed.description: The split of the 24 distributed rolls (on top of the 2 fixed rolls per substat type, which every build has).

rolls.description: Substat type -> number of distributed rolls. A type left out has 0. The counts must add up to 24 and respect the per-stat cap; the loader checks both (see the schema description).

notes.description: Free text for people. The simulator ignores it. In a draft file this is where each choice's reason is written, with every guess marked "GUESS".

set_id.description: The set's id as HSR-Scanner v4 writes it in a relic's set_id, e.g. "117".

name.description: The set's name as Fribbels spells it (the value of Sets.<Key> in constants.ts), e.g. "Pioneer Diver of Dead Waters".
